description:
Steam Deck and Framework owners both got caught in data breaches, but the plot twist is neither company was actually hacked. Both leaked through upstream vendors most customers have never heard of, exposing names, emails, phone numbers, and home addresses. Here's exactly what to do if you were affected, step by step. From phishing to aliasing to password management.
